children: AIsa said it completed its seed extension round, with Tether and HIVEN joining as strategic investors. According to Cointelegraph, the funding brings AIsa’s total raised to more than $9 million, and the new investors join existing backers Alibaba, Tribe Capital, Sumitomo Corporation, Draper Associates and Saison Capital, among others. Jordan Liu, AIsa’s founder and CEO, said in a Friday statement that the company aims to build infrastructure allowing AI agents to find, access and pay for resources globally while giving enterprises control over permissions, spending and transactions. The San Francisco-based company is developing what it calls the Trusted Resource and Transaction Network for Enterprise AI Agents. Its infrastructure connects enterprise agents with external data, AI search, models, APIs, software tools and industry services, while providing governed access, usage metering, billing and settlement. AIsa said fragmented providers, integrations and billing systems have made it difficult for enterprise AI agents to function in production and operate at scale. Cointelegraph reported on July 31 that Tether posted a net operating profit of $1.5 billion for the second quarter, primarily supported by interest income from its US Treasury holdings and repurchase agreements backed by government securities.

title: Tether Joins AIsa as Strategic Investor as Startup Completes Seed Extension
